Results.ReviewText: This grill is a replacement for the Weber Grill we had for over twenty years.  We used to buy the cheaper grills and they would only last about five years.  Since our last Weber Grill lasted so long, we will always purchase Weber Grills if they continue to be long lasting and dependable.  This grill is good looking and well made.  It has three burners, which I really like better than the one we had before that only had two burners (side to side).  The burners are front to back on our new grill which is a better design.  That way if you want to cook a small amount of food, you can leave one or two of the burners off.

Results.ReviewText: This Is a Great Grill!!!   I've gone through a number of gas grills in my time and this is the best of the best!  Electric start, VERY easy to clean and cooks foods throughly and quickly.  One the problem with the other grills is that the food drippings would permanently lodge in the bottom of the grill and cause a real mess, which was impossible to clean unless you actually hosed it out.  That's not the case with the Weber.  You can remove everything and clean the entire bottom of the grill with no problems or unhooking anything.  You can even replace the aluminum drip pan with a replacement that you can get at ACE Hardware.  It's a whole new grilling experience!!!
Results.Title: It's a whole new grilling experience!!!

Results.ReviewText: My wife gave the Spirit II E-310,  as a Father's Day gift to replace my 20 year old Weber Genesis. I found it very helpful to watch a couple videos for assembling it before taking everything out of the box.  I was about halfway through the assembly and a main frame, without the wheels, was bent to badly to use. I called up Weber and had the replacement part in about a week. Finished the assembly, did the pre-burn before using. I love the larger knobs, thermometer, and how it is so easy to move. The grill interior is the perfect size for meals for 3-4 people. The cooking is very well balanced. So I'm glad to continue my love of Weber gas grills for another 20 years!
Results.Title: 20 years with Weber

Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
